title: Only enable automatic Copilot review triggers when opted in
summary: Automatic Copilot review workflow triggers now activate only when explicitly opted in through settings, preventing unintended workflow runs from templates that bypass the updater's inclusion logic.
key_points: Copilot review workflows ship with only manual dispatch triggers by default
The updater adds pull_request and workflow_run triggers only when CodeReviewAgent.enabled is true
Templates prevent automatic reviews from activating in repositories using outdated updaters
Settings schema and Copilot scenario documentation updated to reflect the opt-in requirement
Comprehensive tests added to validate trigger configuration and workflow file handling
quote: Automatic triggers in those raw files therefore activate workflows before review is enabled.
